items.briefing:
New research from Commvault finds that one in three organisations across Australia and New Zealand still pay ransomware demands — a concerning trend that often doesn't guarantee data recovery. Separately, a NSW government audit has found major agencies are repeatedly failing the same cybersecurity controls, suggesting systemic issues rather than one-off mistakes. These findings are a reminder that basic security practices remain inconsistent even in large, well-resourced organisations.

For staff using AI tools or cloud services, be aware that the access and permissions you grant can be difficult to track or revoke later — so only connect tools and accounts that are genuinely necessary.

**Practical tip:** Before linking any new app or AI tool to your work accounts, check with your IT team first.

featured.title: One in three ANZ organisations still pay ransomware demands, Commvault research says
featured.quote: One in three ANZ organisations still pay ransomware demands, revealing widespread vulnerability.
